dedupe_keys.name: rrt lithuania electronic communications quarterly statistics and provider periodic reports open data

description: The Communications Regulatory Authority of Lithuania publishes its market statistics as open data. The quarterly statistical indicators dataset sums the quarterly reports of electronic communications providers whose revenue from electronic communications in the previous calendar year was 300 thousand euros or more. It is a long table with an indicator group, an indicator name and a value, covering subscriptions, traffic and revenue for fixed and mobile telephony, internet access and television. A second dataset lists the providers of electronic communications services together with the data from their periodic reports. Both were issued in August 2026 and replace an older combined dataset of providers of electronic communications and postal services and their statistics. Matching datasets cover postal services. Coverage: Lithuania, national totals by quarter, with provider-level report data in the second dataset. Format and access: CSV on data.gov.lt, free; the portal lists CC BY 4.0 for RRT data. Caveats: small providers below the revenue threshold are left out of the quarterly totals; the start of the series and the full indicator list were not checked because the portal returned errors to automated requests. Simulation uses: demand and traffic baselines by service for Lithuanian telecom models. Related records: the Nordic and Baltic telecom market statistics compare Lithuania with its neighbours; the Digital Decade DESI indicators give EU coverage and take-up.
licence: CC BY 4.0 (as listed for RRT datasets on data.gov.lt)
